episodeTitle.en: Figma’s CEO: Why AI makes design, craft, and quality the new moat for startups | Dylan Field
episodeTitle.zh: Figma首席执行官：为何人工智能让设计、工艺和质量成为初创公司的新护城河 | Dylan Field

guestBioOfficial.en: Dylan Field is co-founder and CEO of Figma, a beloved tool used by every modern product team. Founded in 2012, Figma has expanded from a single design tool to a comprehensive platform including FigJam, Slides, Dev Mode, and, most recently, Figma Make. After a $20 billion acquisition by Adobe fell through due to regulatory pushback, Dylan led the company to a successful IPO in 2025. *What you’ll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh:
迪伦·菲尔德（Dylan Field）是Figma的联合创始人兼首席执行官，Figma是每个现代产品团队都喜爱的工具。Figma成立于2012年，从单一设计工具发展为一个综合平台，涵盖FigJam、Slides、Dev Mode以及最近推出的Figma Make。在Adobe以200亿美元收购Figma因监管阻力而失败后，迪伦于2025年成功带领公司完成IPO。

title.en: Figma’s CEO: Why AI makes design, craft, and quality the new moat for startups | Dylan Field
title.zh: Figma首席执行官：为何人工智能让设计、工艺和质量成为初创公司的新护城河 | Dylan Field

summary.en: Dylan reflects on how Figma stayed focused and motivated after the failed Adobe acquisition, and how his own leadership has evolved over 13 years. He shares the counterintuitive bet behind FigJam—making 'fun' the differentiator—and lays out his vision for Figma Make as a way to let anyone prototype and shape product direction. He argues that craft and design are now essential to winning in software, that market-size thinking is the wrong lens for new product lines, and that organizations should expect to get better as AI models improve rather than shrink headcount.
summary.zh: Dylan 回顾了在 Adobe 收购告吹后，Figma 如何保持专注与动力，以及他本人在 13 年间的领导力蜕变。他分享了 FigJam 背后那个反直觉的赌注——把“有趣”作为差异化卖点，并阐述了 Figma Make 的愿景：让任何人都能参与原型设计与产品方向的塑造。他认为，在软件行业取胜的关键在于工艺与设计，用市场规模来思考新产品线是错误的方式，而组织应期待随着 AI 模型进步变得更强，而不是缩减人手。
